summary: Receives audio from stream sources such as server/RTSP-style streams, Video Stream In TOP, or WebRTC connections.
key_concepts: Audio Stream In CHOP streams audio into TouchDesigner from an RTSP-style server URL or a WebRTC peer.
Server source mode uses Server URL, while WebRTC source mode uses a WebRTC DAT, connection, and track.
Video Stream In TOP can be referenced when the incoming video stream carries embedded audio.
Audio Sync Offset compensates for playback latency when stream audio must align with images.
Info CHOP channels expose stream state such as sample, seconds, open, opening, and open_failed.

key_params.name: srctype
key_params.note: Source type such as server or WebRTC

key_params.name: url
key_params.note: Server URL when using server stream source

key_params.name: videostreamintop
key_params.note: Video Stream In TOP source for associated audio

key_params.name: webrtc
key_params.note: WebRTC DAT when using WebRTC source

common_gotchas: Network stream availability depends on URL, peer state, ports, and firewall/network routing.
Use sync offset when pairing stream audio with video.
WebRTC mode requires matching WebRTC DAT, connection, peer, and track names.
Open timeout should be set with the expected network conditions in mind.
